numbering_note: Paired with kb/ceremonies/ceremony-13-review-88-lessons-that-run.json. Every finding appears exactly once.

applied.change: Added `capability` as a second unit. A candidate is a row in state/lessons.jsonl whose sharper_check names no tool that exists, or names one tools/phase.py does not run -- a lesson that is written down and does not run. Plan items now carry `unit` and `kind`; skill items keep their `skill` key so nothing about the existing behaviour changed. cmd_check re-reads the lessons file for a capability item rather than trusting the improve record, because asserting a lesson now runs is exactly the move the stop condition exists to refuse. Five candidates surfaced on the first scan.

Recorded the recurrence as data and ranked on it: the three ceremony-75 rows now carry `recurred_at: [12-79-reference-example]` with a note naming how each came back, and capability_candidates sorts recurred-first, then no-tool-at-all, then oldest. The plan of one then selected 75-run-boundary -- a lesson with demonstrated rather than argued cost -- instead of the cheapest item.

Wired `improvement_loop.py check` into tools/phase.py as a blocking gate, with the reason in a comment: a non-blocking improvement gate is a lesson that runs and decides nothing. Proven in both directions before trusting it -- exit 1 naming three unmoved items on a plan of three, exit 0 on the fired plan of one. Gates 19 to 20.

The stop condition is exists AND wired, so the loop measures execution rather than presence. STATUS row 88 restated on that definition: 2 of 10 wired, down from the flattering 5 of 9. The four tools that exist and are unwired (litmus_check, litmus_answers, spot_check, and improvement_loop before this ceremony) are now ranked candidates rather than an unmeasured claim -- and litmus_check turns out to be red with 3 errors nobody was seeing, which the next plan inherits.

--selftest now plants the document arm as well as the interface arm: it copies the live area into a temp dir, adds an entries/human.json declaring `door` and `deadline_seconds` that no knobs entry vouches for, and requires both reported undeclared. Without it the arm would have shipped green having never run on any input.

Closed 75-run-boundary on the two arms actually covered, kept its original text under `sharper_check_original`, and split the uncovered third into a new lesson row 12b-extension-points with its own sharper_check -- explicitly not yet a command, with what it would take and the instruction to plant a row before trusting it. The loop now ranks the remainder instead of the parent reading as finished.

owner_note: The owner's correction was right and is recorded rather than smoothed over: this work was asked for one turn earlier, in almost these words, and was deferred back to them as an owner-level design decision about what the loop optimises. Widening a loop so it can take a finding as an item is not a change to what it optimises -- it is the difference between a loop that can react and one that cannot. The standing instruction is to decide and keep it additive, which is what the second attempt did.
